PreToolUse.exec: bash -c 'git diff --cached --name-only | grep -qE "\.env\.local|\.env$" && echo "ERROR: .env file staged — aborting." && exit 1 || true'
bash -c 'echo "⚠️ packages/mobile/android/ 是 Expo 构建产物，不应提交到 git。如需提交，先确认 .gitignore 已配置。" && exit 1 || true'

PostToolUse.exec: bash -c 'if git diff --name-only | grep -qE "\.(ts|tsx)$"; then npx eslint --fix --quiet $(git diff --name-only | grep -E "\.(ts|tsx)$") 2>/dev/null; fi'
